design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (group_room_block_contracts), frozen_time 2026-10-07 10:20:00 EDT.

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "factor_counts": [5, 4]}. The reduction computation takes 5 factors, the interim deposit 4.

2. Why it is a good test. The bride calls only to pay her overdue second deposit. The desk must (a) read the interim deposit policy and find its prerequisite sentence 'The interim deposit is worked out only after every signed room-night reduction addendum on the block is matched by a reduction entry on the block ledger that names it.'; (b) read the addenda and ledger and see that the 2026-08-13 reduction addendum is signed but unimplemented; (c) work out from the reduction policy that its write is the one that books that reduction entry; (d) compute the room nights removed through five ladders (count start, reduction percentage, allowance measure, Rewards courtesy, earlier-reduction weight) over the addenda, ledger, signing-deposit date and the Ashbury Rewards ledger, and only partly honour the 18 requested room nights (14); (e) then compute the interim deposit on the reduced contract through four more ladders (late receipt, reduction exposure, linked event deposit, deposit true-up) and hand the payment to the organiser. Difficulty comes from discovering the hidden reduction and from arithmetic over reconciled history, never from tool choice (one tool per problem).

3. Scope. Claimed: group_ext_reduction_room_nights (tool implement_block_reduction_df5160bf, agent) and group_ext_interim_deposit_amount (tool pay_group_deposit_93013531, user). Left to task 1: the cancellation family on a no-deposit Tour & Travel block (signed cancellation with damages, cut-off release, increase implementation), whose policies, tools and events (group_contract_cancel, group_cancellation_charge, group_cutoff_release, group_block_increase) are disjoint from these.

4. Problem-tree card. Root: group_ext_interim_deposit_amount (on_request; the caller's 'second deposit'). Prerequisite: group_ext_reduction_room_nights (state_due). Edge interim -> reduction: kind value_input, gate binding revenue, form state, sentence as in 2(a) (affirmative 'only after'; four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; record-visible state 'a reduction entry on the block ledger that names it'; no tool/id/code token; scope 'every signed room-night reduction addendum on the block', exactly the condition). Exactly one write of this difficulty books a reduction entry naming an addendum: the reduction policy's ('implemented by one reduction entry on the block ledger that names the addendum'). Seed falsity: group_amendments[A3=2026-08-13].status = signed, amendment_type = room_night_reduction, while the only group_block_reduce entry (2026-06-22) has amendment_id = the June addendum; contracted_room_nights = 90. Resolution order: reduction, interim. Deletion sensitivity (probe run): skipping the reduction gives deposit 4791.15 instead of 4158.00 and contracted 90 instead of 76. The persona names no prerequisite (only a conditional reaction after the agent explains); the tools validate nothing.

5. Base-invariant card. Reduction write (group_block_amend + group_block_reduce, base group_addenda): definite_only (status definite, B0) holds; addendum_signed (A3 signed) holds; reduction_deadline (time: anchor group_blocks.arrival_date 2027-01-15, clock frozen_time, not_after, 90 calendar days, inclusive): 100 days out, holds; boundary 2026-10-17 accepted, 2026-10-18 refused; implemented_once: no entry names A3. reduction_allowance is retired by the declared overwrite of its sentence (the extended policy implements the request up to the open allowance instead of refusing it). Deposit write (group_deposit_receive, base group_deposit_schedule): receivable_state (definite) holds; once_per_milestone is retired by the declared overwrite 'an interim deposit is received at most once on a block, so a block whose ledger already carries an interim deposit receipt takes no second one' (same rule restated per deposit kind; the base dedup gate binds a ledger entry_basis value that no pre-action record can carry for a deposit not yet received), and the ledger carries only the signing receipt.

6. Business-object card. Target block B0 (YCW115). Addendum implemented: A3 (latest signed reduction; A4 2026-09-24 is withdrawn, A1 is an increase, A2 is already named by entry L4). Ledger rows read: L1 allocation 84 (room nights at signing), L2 signing deposit 1587.60 (date 2025-11-07), L3 increase 12 (2026-03-02), L4 reduction 6 (2026-06-22). Deposits received = L2 only. Cross reads: loyalty membership (Platinum, active) and its 4 stay_base credits within 24 months (2024-08-12 credit excluded); meeting contract MC0 (Wedding Celebration Package, definite, deposit 5362.50, group_block_id = B0).

7. Factor card (probe run on the handling-time worlds).
 Reduction (step 11, world = opening): count start method -> 125 lead days (baseline 100 -> result 10); reduction percentage 15 (baseline 10 -> 10); allowance measure 90 (baseline 84 -> 13); courtesy 4 (baseline 0 -> 10); earlier-reduction weight 3 (baseline 6 -> 11). Result 14; all-baseline result 2. Near-misses: the withdrawn A4 is newer than A3; the 2024-08-12 stay credit is outside 24 months; the June reduction's lead (207 days) sits on the early tier while today's raw lead (100) would fall through.
 Interim (step 13, world = opening + step 11): late load +5 (baseline 0 -> 3439.80); reduction exposure load +5, 20 reduced room nights against the 84 allocated (baseline 0 -> 3439.80); event relief -5 (baseline 0 -> 4876.20); true-up cumulative method (baseline standalone -> 4309.20). Result 4158.00; all-baseline 3591.00 (25 % of 76 x 189.00). Near-miss: the meeting contract's deposit is compared with event_deposit_floor_usd, and the deposit received by the block (1587.60) is not the event deposit.

8. Seed rationale. Block + four ledger rows + four addenda are the whole contract history (every row moves a factor or the prerequisite). Five past checked-out Member Flexible Rate stays carry the Rewards credits (base points = spend x 10 at Ashbury Hotel/Grand; the elite bonus at 50 % only for the May 2026 stay, the tier having taken effect 2026-03-01; night credits 5 in 2026); points_balance 29440 = the credits seeded. The meeting contract and its signing deposit (25 % of 130 x 165.00 = 5362.50) are consistent with the Meetings & Events charter, and its ninety-day deposit falls due 2026-10-18, after frozen_time. No row lights another obligation: the block's cut-off is 2026-12-16, no master entries exist, the folio/loyalty rows are settled history.

9. Persona design. A busy pharmacist-bride, apologetic about the late deposit; she volunteers the surface goal (pay the second deposit now, card on file) and the booking code; identity details only when asked; the August addendum only as a conditional memory after the agent explains a prerequisite; she accepts the partial reduction and the amount, runs the payment herself and closes on the receipt. No ask outside the two writes.

10. Standard solution. find_customers -> verify (phone + ZIP) -> find_group_blocks(YCW115) -> find_group_amendments -> find_group_ledger -> find_loyalty_memberships -> find_loyalty_transactions -> find_booking_reservations -> find_meeting_contracts -> find_meeting_ledger -> unlock + call implement_block_reduction_df5160bf(B0, A3, 14) -> unlock_user + user calls pay_group_deposit_93013531(B0, deposit_interim, 4158.00).

11. Verification. /tmp authoring probe (check_compute primitives) printed: reduction result 14, sens {10, 10, 13, 10, 11}, all-baseline 2; interim result 4158.0, sens {3439.8, 4876.2, 3439.8, 4309.2}, all-baseline 3591.0. Per-task gates are recorded in the difficulty worklog.

12. Draft recomputation from visible context only (policy prose, tool schemas, finder returns, persona lines): 'can it be handled now' -> yes, block definite, 100 days out; object -> block YCW115, addendum of 2026-08-13; writes -> reduction then deposit (the deposit sentence names the reduction entry); parameters -> 14 and 4158.00, identical to gold.

13. Rework round 2 (policy-task audit). F-G2/T0-F1: the co-brand-card rewards relief was not a condition group sales weighs for a group deposit; replaced by the reduction exposure load (how far signed reductions have shrunk the contract against the allocation entry), a risk measure hotels do weigh when scheduling group deposits. The interim keeps 4 factors (3 parameter, 1 method); the deposit moves 3080.70 -> 4158.00 and the skip-reduction figure 3940.65 -> 4791.15. O-G3: the deposit dedup sentence now covers both deposit kinds. O-G8: the reduction selection sentence no longer says 'in the order they were issued'. O-T0-2: the event-deposit relief is no longer labelled multi-source. O-T0-1: the booking-reservation and meeting-ledger reads are kept: they confirm the stay credits belong to completed stays and the event deposit was actually received, and every seeded row must be read for the closure.
user_scenario: You are Danielle Ybarra, 33, a hospital pharmacist in San Diego who is organising the hotel side of her own wedding weekend at the Ashbury Grand in January. You are friendly, a little frazzled and apologetic, and you talk in short, practical sentences between shifts. You open by giving your name and saying you are calling about your wedding room block, booking code YCW115: an email reminder told you the second deposit on the block is past due, you feel bad about missing it, and you want to pay the second deposit today with the card already on your profile. You do not know what the amount should be and you never suggest one. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give the phone number 619-555-5274 and the billing ZIP code 92103; only if a further detail is asked for do you add your email danielle.ybarra@ybarracastellanoswedding.com or your date of birth, 18 April 1993, and the card on file ends in 5318. If the agent asks about other things you hold with Ashbury, you say the reception itself is booked with the hotel's catering team as well, and that you are an Ashbury Rewards Platinum member, number 405318264; you do not know the balances or dates of any of them. If the agent tells you that something on the block has to be put through before the deposit can be worked out and explains what it is, you remember signing paperwork in August to take some room nights off because fewer cousins are flying in, you say you think it asked for 18 room nights but that the agent should go by what the paper says, and you tell them to go ahead and do whatever is needed for it. If the agent then tells you that fewer room nights came off than you asked for, you accept it calmly because that is what the contract allows. Once the agent tells you the amount of the second deposit you accept it without arguing, and when the agent hands the payment step over to you, you run it yourself with exactly the amount and details the agent gives you and read back the receipt number it shows. If the agent instead asks you to read out a card number, you say you would rather pay with the card that is already on file. After the payment goes through and you have the receipt, you thank the agent warmly and end the call.

request_alignment.claim: The organiser wants to pay the overdue second (interim) deposit on her wedding room block today with the card on her profile.
evidence: user_scenario:you want to pay the second deposit today with the card already on your profile

request_alignment.claim: The block is identified by its booking code.

gold_actions.business_effect: One group_block_reduce entry of 14 room nights naming the signed 2026-08-13 addendum; contracted and held room nights fall from 90 to 76.

request_binding.action_semantics: A signed reduction addendum with no reduction entry naming it is an implementation the block already owes (state_due); it is the only write that brings about the state the interim deposit's prerequisite sentence waits on, and it is distinct from issuing or signing an addendum, which are already done.

discriminator.business_meaning: signed room-night reduction addendum not yet named by any reduction entry

stage_provenance.fact: The addendum was signed by the organiser before the call (status signed); this call performs its implementation synchronously.

base_preconditions.condition: A block is amended only while its status is definite.

The contracted room nights of a definite block change only through an addendum that the organiser signs; guest services may issue the addendum, but it takes effect only once its status is signed, and each signed addendum is implemented once, by one block update and one ledger entry naming it.
A reduction addendum must be signed no later than free_reduction_deadline_days calendar days before the block's arrival date.

gold_actions.business_effect: One group_deposit_receive entry of 4158.00 with entry_basis deposit_interim; deposit held 1587.60 -> 5745.60.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller asks to pay the second deposit, which on a Wedding Room Block is the interim deposit (the signing deposit was received 2025-11-07); paying a deposit is the organiser's own act, so it is the user-owned deposit payment, not a master-account payment.

evidence: user_scenario:you want to pay the second deposit today with the card already on your profile
user_scenario:you want to pay the second deposit today with the card already on your profile

stage_provenance.fact: The organiser pays the interim deposit in this contact; the contracted room nights it is computed on were brought up to date by the reduction implemented at step 11.
evidence: user_scenario:you want to pay the second deposit today with the card already on your profile

base_preconditions.condition: Deposits are received only while the block's status is tentative or definite.

temporal_feasibility.condition: A reduction addendum must be signed no later than free_reduction_deadline_days calendar days before the block's arrival date.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Days are counted as whole calendar days back from the arrival date; an addendum signed exactly free_reduction_deadline_days days before arrival is accepted.

boundary_check.just_before: On 2026-10-18, 89 calendar days before the 2027-01-15 arrival, the Wedding Room Block deadline of 90 days has passed and the reduction would not be implemented.
boundary_check.at_boundary: On 2026-10-17, exactly 90 days before arrival, the reduction is still accepted (inclusive); at frozen_time 2026-10-07 the block is 100 days out, so the gate holds.

Phone number for lookup and verification

seed_consistency.check: Wedding Room Block, 30 rooms on the peak night (10 to 75), 84 room nights at signing (at least 20), arrival 438 days after the proposal (at most 730); signed 2025-11-10, 7 days after the 2025-11-03 proposal (within option_validity_days 14) after the signing deposit was received 2025-11-07; cut-off 2026-12-16 = arrival - 30; contracted 90 = 84 + 12 - 6 and held 90 = allocations + increases - reductions; deposit_held 1587.60 = the one signing deposit; master_balance 0 with no master entries.
One contract_block allocation of 84 room nights dated the proposal date 2025-11-03, amount 0.00.
Signing deposit = round(84 x 189.00 x 10 / 100, 2) = 1587.60, received 2025-11-07, within signing_deposit_due_days 7 of the proposal, while the block was tentative.
Increase of 12 room nights implementing the signed 2026-02-23 increase addendum once, on a definite block.

Reduction of 6 room nights implementing the signed 2026-06-08 reduction addendum once, 207 days before arrival (before the 90-day deadline); the addendum asked for 6, within the allowance open at the time, so all 6 were removed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the organiser's profile from the name and phone number the caller states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the organiser's customer reference; nothing can be read before the profile is found.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the in-session identity verification with the phone number and billing ZIP code the caller states (2 matching details).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No group business may be discussed or carried out until verification passes; the phone and ZIP match the profile.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the block under booking code YCW115: block type Wedding Room Block, status definite, arrival 2027-01-15, contracted room nights 90, group rate 189.00, proposal date 2025-11-03, contract signed 2025-11-10, deposit held 1587.60.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The block's type gives the tier parameters (deposit_interim_pct 25, deposit_interim_days_before_arrival 120, deposit_signing_pct 10, signing_deposit_due_days 7, free_reduction_pct 10, free_reduction_deadline_days 90); its dates feed the days past due, the reduction lead days and the increase window; its contracted room nights and group rate feed the anticipated room revenue.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the block's contract addenda: the reduction addendum issued 2026-08-13 for 18 room nights is signed, the 2026-09-24 reduction addendum is withdrawn, and the 2026-02-23 increase and 2026-06-08 reduction addenda are signed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This read reveals the prerequisite: the interim deposit is worked out only after every signed reduction addendum is matched by a reduction entry, and the 2026-08-13 addendum is signed with no entry naming it; it also gives the addendum's issue date and requested room nights for the reduction computation.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the block ledger: allocation 84 room nights (2025-11-03), signing deposit 1587.60 received 2025-11-07, increase 12 room nights (2026-03-02, naming the February addendum), reduction 6 room nights (2026-06-22, naming the June addendum); no entry names the August addendum and no interim deposit has been received.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the room nights contracted at signing, the increase entry and its date (allowance measure), the earlier reduction and its date (earlier-reduction weight), the signing deposit date (reduction percentage and deposit true-up), the deposits received, and the proof that the August addendum is unimplemented.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the organiser's Ashbury Rewards membership: active Platinum Elite.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides, with the stay credits, the courtesy room nights of the reduction.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the membership's transactions: base-point stay credits posted 2025-02-17, 2025-07-29, 2026-01-20 and 2026-05-04 inside the last 24 months, and one posted 2024-08-12 outside it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Counts the base-point stay credits of the last 24 months (4, at least min_recent_stays 3) that the courtesy room nights rest on; the 2024-08-12 credit is the near-miss the window excludes.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the reservations credited to the organiser's Ashbury Rewards membership: five checked-out Member Flexible Rate stays (2024-08, 2025-02, 2025-07, 2026-01, 2026-05), none naming a group block.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms that the stay credits counted toward the courtesy room nights are base points for the organiser's own completed stays, and that none of them is a reservation inside this block.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the organiser's Meetings & Events contracts: the definite Wedding Celebration Package linked to the block holds a deposit of 5362.50.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the event-deposit relief of the interim deposit (definite and at least event_deposit_floor_usd 3000).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the event contract's ledger: one signing deposit of 5362.50 received 2025-11-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms that the deposit the event contract holds is a deposit actually received (not merely scheduled), which is what the event-deposit relief compares with its floor.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the reduction-implementation tool named by the reduction policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect; unlocked once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Implement the signed August reduction addendum: one reduction entry of 14 room nights naming it, contracted and held room nights 90 -> 76.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The reduction policy's compute uniquely gives the room nights removed (14); this write also brings about the state the interim deposit waits on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.group_block_id: df35cc35-9a50-40ad-a1c2-e4569a7ee409. Basis: the reduction policy's rule 'A signed reduction addendum on a definite block is implemented by one reduction entry on the block ledger that names the addendum, together with one block update'; the block is the one find_group_blocks returned for booking code YCW115, which the caller stated. Uniqueness: the organiser holds one block; no other block reference is reachable.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amendment_id: c24c37e5-9684-43ee-9536-db54d41488a6. Basis: rule 'the addendum implemented is the most recently issued reduction addendum whose status is signed'; find_group_amendments shows four addenda on the block: the 2026-09-24 reduction is withdrawn, the 2026-02-23 one is an increase, the 2026-06-08 reduction is signed but already named by the 2026-06-22 reduction entry; the 2026-08-13 reduction is the latest signed reduction and no entry names it. Uniqueness: every other addendum is excluded by its type, status or an existing entry.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.room_nights_removed: 14. Factors: (1) reduction_count_start (method): the addendum was issued 2026-08-13, 55 days before 2026-10-07 (more than return_period_days 30, no more than second_period_days 60), so the days before arrival are counted from 2026-09-12: DAYS(2026-08-13, 2027-01-15) - 30 = 125 (baseline from today: 100). (2) reduction_percentage (parameter): 125 is at least mid_reduction_days 120 and below early_reduction_days 180, and the signing deposit entry 2025-11-07 is 4 days after the 2025-11-03 proposal (within signing_deposit_due_days 7), so 10 x 1.5 = 15 percent (baseline 10). (3) allowance_measure (parameter): the block carries one increase entry, 12 room nights dated 2026-03-02, 112 days after signing 2025-11-10 (later than increase_window_days 90), so the room nights measured are 84 + 0.5 x 12 = 90 (baseline 84). (4) courtesy_room_nights (parameter, cross-difficulty loyalty): active Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite with 4 base-point stay credits in the last 24 months (at least 3), so 4 courtesy room nights (baseline 0). Allowance = int(90 x 15 / 100) + 4 = 13 + 4 = 17. (5) earlier_reduction_weight (parameter): the earlier reduction entry (6 room nights) is dated 2026-06-22, 207 days before arrival (at least 180), so it counts at 0.5: 3 (baseline 6). Open allowance = int(17 - 3) = 14; removed = min(requested 18, 14) = 14.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Hand the deposit-payment tool to the organiser.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The organiser pays deposits personally; the agent unlocks the user tool once and hands it over with the block reference, the deposit basis and the amount.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The organiser pays the interim deposit of 4158.00 on the block: one receipt with the interim basis, deposit held 1587.60 -> 5745.60.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The interim deposit policy's compute, evaluated after the reduction entry exists, uniquely gives 4158.00.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.group_block_id: df35cc35-9a50-40ad-a1c2-e4569a7ee409. Basis: the deposit tool docstring 'the reference number of the organiser's group room block, which guest services reads from the group block lookup and gives to the organiser'; the agent hands over the block found under YCW115. Uniqueness: the organiser's only block.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.entry_basis: deposit_interim. Basis: the deposit tool docstring 'deposit_interim — the interim deposit due a set number of days before arrival' and the caller's 'second deposit on the block is past due'; the interim deposit policy's rule 'the payment is one deposit receipt with the interim basis'. Uniqueness: deposit_signing is the signing deposit already received on 2025-11-07; every other value is marked 'not used here' in the docstring.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.deposit_amount: 4158.00, evaluated after the 14-room-night reduction entry exists (contracted room nights 76). Anticipated room revenue = 76 x 189.00 = 14364.00. (1) late_receipt_load (parameter): due date 120 days before 2027-01-15 is 2026-09-17; paid 2026-10-07, 20 days past due, more than late_grace_days 14, so +5 points (baseline 0). (2) reduction_exposure_load (parameter): the reduction entries carry 6 + 14 = 20 room nights against the 84 of the allocation entry, 23.8 percent, at least high_exposure_pct 15, so +5 points (baseline 0). (3) event_deposit_relief (parameter, Meetings & Events): the linked Wedding Celebration Package is definite and holds 5362.50, at least event_deposit_floor_usd 3000, so -5 points (baseline 0). Applicable interim percentage = 25 + 5 + 5 - 5 = 30. (4) deposit_true_up (method): the ledger carries reduction entries and the signing deposit was received within 7 days of the proposal, so the amount is (30 + 10) x 14364.00 / 100 - 1587.60 deposits received = 5745.60 - 1587.60 = 4158.00 (baseline method 30 x 14364.00 / 100 = 4309.20). Rounded to the cent once: 4158.00.

factor_trace: reduction_count_start (method): addendum issued 2026-08-13 15:10:00 EDT (latest signed reduction), 55 days before 2026-10-07, more than return_period_days 30 but no more than second_period_days 60 -> counted from 30 days after issue: DAYS(2026-08-13, 2027-01-15) - 30 = 125; baseline (from the implementation date) 100; result under baseline 10.

reduction_percentage (parameter): 125 days is at least mid_reduction_days 120 and below early_reduction_days 180, and the signing deposit entry 2025-11-07 is 4 days after the 2025-11-03 proposal (within signing_deposit_due_days 7) -> free_reduction_pct 10 x mid_reduction_multiplier 1.5 = 15; baseline 10; result under baseline 10.

allowance_measure (parameter): one increase entry of 12 room nights dated 2026-03-02, 112 days after the 2025-11-10 signing (later than increase_window_days 90) -> 84 + late_increase_share 0.5 x 12 = 90; baseline 84 (allocation only); result under baseline 13.

courtesy_room_nights (parameter, cross-difficulty loyalty, multi-source): active Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite AND 4 stay_base credits posted 2025-02-17, 2025-07-29, 2026-01-20, 2026-05-04 within 24 months (the 2024-08-12 credit is outside) -> platinum_courtesy_nights 4; baseline 0; result under baseline 10.

earlier_reduction_weight (parameter): earlier reduction entry 6 room nights dated 2026-06-22, 207 days before arrival (at least early_reduction_days 180) -> counted at early_reduction_weight 0.5 = 3; baseline in full 6; result under baseline 11.
plumbing: requested = 18 (requested room nights on the August addendum); allowance = int(90 x 15 / 100) + 4 = 17; open_allowance = MX(int(17 - 3), 0) = 14; result = MN(18, 14) = 14.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the days before arrival are at least mid_reduction_days but fewer than early_reduction_days and the signing deposit entry is so dated
the addendum was issued more than return_period_days but no more than second_period_days calendar days before it is implemented
the latest increase entry is dated later than increase_window_days calendar days after signing
the organiser's active membership is Platinum, Titanium or Ambassador Elite AND carries at least min_recent_stays base-point stay credits in the last 24 months
the latest earlier reduction entry is dated early_reduction_days or more calendar days before arrival

factor_trace: late_receipt_load (parameter): due date = 2027-01-15 - 120 days = 2026-09-17; paid 2026-10-07 -> 20 days past due, more than late_grace_days 14 -> late_load_high_points 5; baseline 0; result under baseline 3439.80.

event_deposit_relief (parameter, Meetings & Events): linked Wedding Celebration Package is definite and holds a deposit of 5362.50 (two fields of the one event contract), at least event_deposit_floor_usd 3000 -> event_relief_high_points 5; baseline 0; result under baseline 4876.20.

reduction_exposure_load (parameter): reduction entries 6 (2026-06-22) + 14 (step 11) = 20 room nights against the allocation entry's 84 = 23.8 percent, at least high_exposure_pct 15 -> exposure_load_high_points 5; baseline 0; result under baseline 3439.80.

deposit_true_up (method, multi-source): the ledger carries 2 reduction entries AND the signing deposit entry is 4 days after the proposal -> (applicable 30 + deposit_signing_pct 10) x 14364.00 / 100 - deposits received 1587.60 = 4158.00; baseline method 30 x 14364.00 / 100 = 4309.20; result under baseline 4309.20.
plumbing: revenue = contracted 76 (after step 11) x 189.00 = 14364.00; applicable_pct = 25 + 5 + 5 - 5 = 30; result = RND(MX(4158.00, 0), 2) = 4158.00.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the interim deposit is paid more than late_grace_days calendar days after its due date
the organiser's Meetings & Events contract linked to the block is definite AND the deposit it holds is at least event_deposit_floor_usd
the room nights of the block's reduction entries are at least high_exposure_pct percent of its allocation entry
the block ledger carries reduction entries AND the signing deposit entry is dated within signing_deposit_due_days calendar days of the proposal date

edges.condition: Every group_amendments row of the block with amendment_type room_night_reduction and status signed is named by the amendment_id of a group_block_reduce entry on the block's group_ledger, so that group_blocks.contracted_room_nights already reflects every signed reduction.
edges.policy_source: The interim deposit is worked out only after every signed room-night reduction addendum on the block is matched by a reduction entry on the block ledger that names it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The reduction addendum issued 2026-08-13 is signed, but no group_block_reduce entry names it (the only reduction entry names the June addendum), so the contracted room nights still include the room nights it removes.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: implement_block_reduction_df5160bf writes a group_block_reduce entry with amendment_id = the August addendum and room_nights 14, and contracted_room_nights becomes 76; the binding revenue falls from 90 x 189.00 = 17010.00 to 14364.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single prerequisite edge: the reduction must be written before the deposit, as the prerequisite sentence 'The interim deposit is worked out only after every signed room-night reduction addendum on the block is matched by a reduction entry on the block ledger that names it.' pins it; the reverse order computes the deposit on 90 contracted room nights (4791.15) and leaves a different terminal ledger.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the reduction write leaves contracted_room_nights 90 and only the 6-room-night June reduction entry (7.1 percent of the allocation, so the exposure load drops to 2.5 points): the interim deposit recomputes to (27.5 + 10) x 17010.00 / 100 - 1587.60 = 4791.15 instead of 4158.00, the block keeps 90 contracted and held room nights instead of 76, and no reduction entry names the August addendum.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona volunteers only the overdue second deposit, the booking code and the wish to pay with the card on file. The August reduction addendum is mentioned only inside the conditional reaction 'If the agent tells you that something on the block has to be put through before the deposit can be worked out and explains what it is'; she never raises addenda, reductions, contracted room nights or any ordering on her own.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: pay_group_deposit_93013531 reads only the block row to raise deposit_held and writes the receipt whatever the state of the addenda; implement_block_reduction_df5160bf writes the entry and the block update without checking status, deadlines or allowances. Neither function contains a condition that refuses, errors or hints (task_tools.py).
